findings.title: Echo capture and actual class Reaction were separate budgets
findings.before: For the same actor, Echo capture decrements CopyCaptures.reactions only. A linked Shaman still has reactions=1, and the Mirrorsage shared action pool still has reaction=True. The old package tests do not test this interaction.
findings.after: Bind capture to the supplied existing counted Shaman or Boolean Mirrorsage Reaction field before any turn/capture history. Read and debit that same field; query current body/world Reaction legality. Binding never refills or merges histories. A real regular start refreshes, an extra turn does not.
findings.scope: Eldritch Echo capture Reaction only. Mimicry still consumes no Reaction. No additional Reaction, general scheduler or class-specific capture entitlement is granted.

findings.title: Reconstructing an adapter with the same canonical ledger resets its local cap
findings.before: An adapted Mend can be committed, then a second CopyPayloadReleases on the same owner/captures/RP/cadence/world/concentration can commit another in the same numbered round because release_rounds is freshly empty. The reproduced RP sequence is44→42→40.
findings.after: Register one copy engine per owner on the supplied canonical concentration ledger, after successful constructor validation. Reject additional direct/payload/class wrappers using it; reuse the original adapter and its receipts. A failed pool/world constructor does not reserve an owner.
findings.scope: This is a finite adapter invariant, not serialization, reload recovery or protection against a caller supplying a different falsely labelled canonical ledger. Persistent authoritative owner identities remain a runtime requirement.

findings.title: Postcommit native body/concentration changes were ignored
findings.before: The existing class commitment validates native Shaman state, but payload resolution later relies only on the copy-world snapshot. Actual body unconscious after commitment still permits Mend30→32. Direct native concentration displacement after Ward commitment still grants4temporaryHP while native and bridge burdens disagree.
findings.after: At resolution consult the actual linked body conscious/canAct state in addition to existing world eligibility; a blocked paid payload consumes no RNG and refunds nothing. Before payload/counter cleanup and world-clock mutation, run the bridge existing validate_current() and reject unintegrated concentration drift without overwriting it.
findings.scope: No automatic synchronization, unknown-source cleanup, actor death transition or general concentration solver is implemented. Rejected concentration drift must be reconciled by the actual source adapter. V/S already performed at commitment are not re-required at payload time.

findings.title: True linked Shaman Step moves only one position view
findings.before: With actual native totem at5ft and native caster at0, a legal copy-world teleport to[-15,0,0] leaves native caster at0. Native aura querying still qualifies the old5ft relation instead of reflecting the20ft separation.
findings.after: Fail closed before any commitment/payment for Step specifically when using ShamanConcentrationBridge. Do not guess a mapping from 3-D CopyWorld position to the native scalar position/aura model.
findings.scope: This blocks an unsupported reference integration path, not the printed Step benefit or Shaman eligibility. All seven bounded contracts remain. The original Shaman/step fixture uses the unlinked finite class pool and remains a valid coordinate-only test; Mirrorsage coordinate-only Step remains likewise limited.

findings.title: An extra-turn ID could be reused as a regular-start ID
findings.before: start_extra rejects regular and extra history, but start_regular checks only regular_turns. A closed extra-turn event can be replayed as an alleged new regular start, updating ordinal and refreshing Reaction.
findings.after: The existing regular-start validation also rejects IDs already present in extra_turns, before mutation. Distinct lawful regular and extra events remain legal.
findings.scope: Defensive identity consistency in the finite timeline. It does not authenticate arbitrary caller assertions of actual turns or supply an extra-turn source.

notSelectedAsDefect.probe: Capture rank ceiling through a temporarily suppressed paid feat-only credential
notSelectedAsDefect.reason: The sources distinguish permanent acquisition/ceiling credentials from current release availability. The supplied release path already checks operative feat availability. No new active-at-capture credential rule is inferred from the raw probe.
